You are the berth planner for this quay. The published plan no longer works. Make a new berth plan for every ship in the table: when it berths, where, and how many quay cranes work it.

Rules (a plan that breaks any of them is infeasible):
- A ship berths at or after its arrival hour.
- It gets between its min and max cranes. Hours alongside = ceil(moves / (28 x cranes)); it departs when the work is done, unless that hour is inside a no-movement window for that ship, in which case it waits alongside (still occupying its sections, cranes free) until the window ends.
- No ship may berth inside a no-movement window that applies to it.
- It occupies `sections` consecutive sections starting at the section you give, all within 2-30.
- No two ships may use the same section in the same hour. Ships already alongside and closed sections are off limits for the hours listed.
  A ship that leaves at hour h frees its sections for a ship berthing at hour h.
- In every hour, the cranes of all ships alongside (including ships already alongside) may not exceed the cranes available that hour.
- At most 3 movements per hour: a ship berthing at hour h and a ship leaving at hour h each count as one movement in hour h.

Cost (lower is better):
- Delay: for each ship, (its sections) x (hours it departs after its planned departure). Leaving early earns nothing.
- Moves: 5 for each scheduled ship you put on a different starting section than planned. Changing the hour or the cranes costs nothing beyond delay. Unscheduled calls have no planned section.
- Priority ships (notes column): their delay counts that many times. Emergency ships (notes column): each hour they dock after their deadline adds the stated amount.

Plan format - one entry per ship, using the ids from the table:
[{"ship": 0, "berth_hour": 36, "section": 22, "cranes": 3}, {"ship": 1, "berth_hour": 163, "section": 24, "cranes": 2}, ...]

Tools:
- get_situation(): this situation again.
- check_plan(plan): lists rule violations in your plan and its cost. You have 10 checks.
- submit_plan(plan): your final answer. It ends the episode and is graded once: an infeasible plan scores low, a feasible one scores higher the closer its cost is to the best possible.
Submit before you run out of turns; an episode that ends without a submission scores 0.

# Terminal Catalunya (BEST), Port of Barcelona - quay 36A, week 15 of 2024
Hour 0 is Monday 08 April 2024 00:00 UTC. Times are whole hours from then.
The quay is sections 2-30 (about 42 m each). A ship needs its number of consecutive sections for its hours alongside.

## Notices
- Gale warning. From hour 245 to hour 270 the wind is above 25 kn: under the port's traffic rules ships of 300 m or more may not berth or leave. From hour 249 to hour 262 it is above 30 kn: no ship may berth or leave. Cranes keep working; a ship that finishes inside a window waits alongside until the window ends.
- Unscheduled call: ship 55 MSC RAVENNA (366 m, 9 sections) arrives at hour 14, has 1232 moves and asks to sail by hour 31. It has no planned slot, so placing it anywhere costs no move penalty.
- Sections 21-28 are closed from hour 39 to hour 81 (fender repair).
- Ship 48 CONTSHIP TOP was delayed leaving Valencia: it now arrives at hour 310 (planned slot hour 287). Its planned departure stays hour 295.
- Ship 54 GSL ELENI was delayed leaving Port Said: it now arrives at hour 320 (planned slot hour 316). Its planned departure stays hour 339.
- Ship 34 BF LETICIA was delayed leaving Algeciras: it now arrives at hour 212 (planned slot hour 207). Its planned departure stays hour 223.
- Ship 27 ALEXIS was delayed leaving Marseille: it now arrives at hour 169 (planned slot hour 156). Its planned departure stays hour 170.
- 3 of the terminal's 13 quay cranes are out of service from hour 152 to hour 194 (gantry repair): 10 cranes in that window.
- Emergency: ship 31 MSC JIANI reports reefer power failures; its cargo is at risk unless it docks by hour 182. Each hour it docks later costs 40 on top of any delay.
- Priority: ship 8 WEC JAN STEEN carries transshipment cargo for a connecting service; each hour it leaves after its planned departure (hour 58) costs three times the usual.

## Already alongside at hour 0 (cannot move)
- MSC CLEA: sections 12-18 until hour 25
- MEGALOPOLIS: sections 21-26 until hour 8
- CONTSHIP ANA: sections 27-30 until hour 5

## Closed sections
- sections 21-28, hours 39-81 (fender repair)

## Quay cranes and movements
- The terminal has 13 quay cranes. From hour 152 to hour 194 only 10 are available.
- At most 3 ships may berth or leave in any one hour (pilots and tugs).
- A crane handles 28 container moves per hour: hours alongside = ceil(moves / (28 x cranes)).
- No berthing or leaving for ships of 300 m or more from hour 245 to hour 270 (wind above 25 kn).
- No berthing or leaving for all ships from hour 249 to hour 262 (wind above 30 kn).
- Each ship already alongside keeps 2 cranes until it leaves.
